To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the wall roughness controls the interface shear behaviour in cyclic slow shear, which is characterized by an interface shear stress S that varies with the shear strain γ and that is strongly dependent on the wall roughness parameter R.

the roughness parameter R _{n} controls the mechanical behaviour of the granular material near the wall in cyclic annular shear, and that the local grain-level or the mesoscale behaviour of the granulate is directly correlated to its global behaviour on the scale of whole sample.

(i) the interface response depends on the roughness parameter R _{n}, (ii) the interface response is characterized by a cyclic evolution of the wall shear stress, (iii) the interface response involves a cyclic variation of the sample volume, (iv) the interface response induces a cyclic variation of displacements at the sample surface, (v) the cyclic variation of the wall shear is related to the cyclic variation of volume and displacements.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanical behaviour in shear of a granulated material near a rough wall in a pressure-controlled annular shear cell and the effect of the interface on this behaviour is investigated.
the study of the effect of roughness on the cyclic behaviour of granular materials in a shear configuration, with the aim to better understand the behaviour of real granular materials in the field.
the influence of the roughness of the solid wall on the mechanical behaviour of the granular material.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the wall roughness has a strong effect on the global response of a granular system.
the interface roughness is an important factor for the mechanical behaviour of granular materials, especially for the shear stress response.
the interface response is a complex function of the wall rougheness, of the applied shear, of the confining pressure and of the sample height.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the interface roughness has an effect on the mechanical behaviour of the material.
the interface roughness plays a crucial role on the cyclic shear of the granular material, which is a key factor for the understanding of the mechanical behaviour of geomaterials.
the roughness of the solid wall plays a major role in the mechanical behaviour of granular materials in cyclic shear.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the interface roughness is the main factor that controls the cyclic response of the granular assembly.
the wall roughness has a strong influence on the cyclic shear behaviour of the granular sample.
the wall roughness is a key parameter in cyclic shear.
